rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to refer to the first letter of a word or name.

example.english: What's the initial of your English name?
example.traditional: 你個英文名嘅頭一個字母係咩呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 jing1 man4 meng2 ge3 tau4 jat1 go3 zi6 mou5 hai6 me1 aa3

rows.note: Use 一開始嘅 as the all-purpose spoken choice for something belonging to the beginning.

example.traditional: 呢個係我一開始嘅諗法。
example.jyutping: ne1 go3 hai6 ngo5 jat1 hoi1 ci2 ge3 nam2 faat3

rows.note: Use 第一個 when initial means first in sequence or position, especially the first letter.

example.english: What's the initial letter of your name?
example.traditional: 你個名嘅第一個字母係咩呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 meng2 ge3 dai6 jat1 go3 zi6 mou5 hai6 me1 aa3
